posts.subject: Mask bugs
posts.bodyHtml:
Hello Dream!


Recently on the knife server alone, there has been many players complaining how the mask they bought is either bugged and that they can't see it even if they try unequipping and equipping it or whatever. I thought I'd just a keep a list of players who have this problem and maybe @Sky or @BlackFire can look into the issue for them.


Player name - Steam Profile

  • Ruben7173 -

Feel free to comment down your problem regarding any bugged shop items below or list someone who has the problem. 👍


Thank you!
~ Doo Doo

The mask bug problem has been already raised to @Nachtfrische, currently I guess @BlackFire is working on it and trying to fix it as far is I know about it already but it's nor fast or easy to write such a script we need to give them as much time as it's needed.
Players just need to wait and have patience.

Ahhh, very well then, i wasn't told of this as people after I told people to look for Sky or Blackfire, they came back to me and said it was all working fine again.


I'll relay this information to the players,


Thank you,
~Doo Doo

Zitat von Doo Doo

(...) after I told people to look for Sky or Blackfire, they came back to me and said it was all working fine again.

Hm, the issue is resolved then? Maybe the database had difficulties verifying the purchases or maybe the !store plugin has some bugs in connection with the CS:GO updates. Blackfire is not working on the issue (if it hasn't resolved itself already) since he is on vacation until the end of this week.
Unfortunately, I can't provide any other information on this bug since I don't have the rights to check the logs / database.


However, if this issue occurs again, wait a few minutes / hours and if it persists, contact me, so I can get in touch with Sky or just message @Sky directly.


Thanks for the help.
